parameters.content:
## HVAC Estimate Recovery Engine
Automatically follows up on sent estimates until the customer books or manual intervention is required. Increases estimate-to-job conversion for HVAC companies.

**Setup required:** connect Google (Sheets Trigger + Sheets), Gmail & Notion credentials, select the HVAC Estimates sheet + Notion database, and paste the Discord Webhook URL.

### 1. Trigger & Validation
Fires when a new estimate row is added. Continues only when an Email exists and Booked = No.

### 2. Normalize Data
Builds clean, personalized fields used across every email, update and alert.

### 3. Follow-up Sequence
Wait 24h → Email #1, wait 48h → Email #2, wait 72h → Final Email #3. Gmail failures continue safely so the sequence never stalls.

### 4. Booking Re-check
Reads the sheet again. If Booked = Yes the workflow stops; otherwise it escalates.

### 5. Escalation
Mark sheet Pending Follow-up, add a Notion "Needs Manual Follow-up" record, and alert the team on Discord. Notion & Discord run independently.

### 6. Error Handling
Notion & Discord route failures to a shared failure log so escalation problems are captured without stopping the workflow.
